review_scope: Complete seven-file SDK package increment versus integrated Phase0/1 baseline, plus exact 92e8..ef17 parent-handle correction and ef17..fcac explicit descriptor ownership correction.

resolved_findings.resolution: Held root and parent directory descriptors, O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW component walks and leaf openat avoid following the swapped parent. Pre/post device+inode checks reject the tested parent/root replacements instead of returning success.
resolved_findings.evidence: Committed read/output parent-symlink swaps and ordinary directory replacement pass; independent root replacement also passes with no output at the replacement path.

resolved_findings.resolution: read_bounded validates fstat before fdopen and explicitly owns the fd in try/finally; fdopen(closefd=False) cannot consume or strand that ownership. build uses the same ownership rule around construction, write and flush.
resolved_findings.evidence: Committed actual directory rejection repeated 20 times preserves /proc/self/fd inventory; independent directory/FIFO/walk failure and injected partial-write controls all retain exact fd inventory.

semantic_review.finding: Fixed allowlist exports only stead-codec, stead-delivery and two versioned cord marks, plus unchanged LICENSE/notices and bounded SDK README. Private fixture client, state, home implementation and administrative wires are not exported.

Strict duplicate-free export lock requires exact keys, types, version/API/Kelvin and exactly seven byte/hash pins. Individual inputs, lock and total archive are bounded. Every input is opened relative to held parents with a regular-file check; output is exclusive create.

Sorted USTAR entries have fixed metadata. Verifier compares the complete bounded supplied bytes to the canonical trusted-checkout package; it neither parses nor extracts the supplied archive. Corruption, trailing bytes and hostile archive members reject.

Existing output is preserved. Root/parent descriptor ownership closes on normal and error paths. Failed write/swap deliberately leaves a newly created file in the originally held directory; no path-based unlink can remove another writer's replacement.

Four Hoon payloads, LICENSE and complete third-party notices exactly match the stated dd0 native baseline. The manifest binds all payloads, reviewed export lock, packager bytes, pinned toolchain, protocol/API and kernel/runtime identities. Historical notice entries are not represented as new dependency adoption.

SDK/root README, DEV_FLOW and ROADMAP describe a developer library fragment and keep independent consumer compilation, complete API/version-negotiation and browser sessions open. Marks carry cords; parsing/ACK collection does not confer business authorization. No product authorization or state implementation changed.

    # os.listdir closes its own transient directory descriptor before this caller rechecks it.
    return {int(x) for x in os.listdir('/proc/self/fd') if os.path.exists('/proc/self/fd/'+x)}
class IndependentSdkControls(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):

        held=self.base/'held-checkout'
        def swapped(name,flags,*args,**kw):

        self.assertEqual(fd_set(),before_fds)

        real_fdopen=os.fdopen;before_fds=fd_set();expected,_=SDK.archive_bytes(self.root)
        @contextlib.contextmanager
        def fail_write(fd,mode,**kwargs):
            with real_fdopen(fd,mode,**kwargs) as stream:
                if mode!='wb':
                    yield stream
                    return
                class Writer:
                    def write(self,data):
                        stream.write(data[:31]);stream.flush()
                        raise OSError(errno.ENOSPC,'authored write-failure control')
                yield Writer()
        with mock.patch.object(SDK.os,'fdopen',side_effect=fail_write):
            with self.assertRaises(OSError) as caught: SDK.build(self.root,'out/partial.tar')
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.errno,errno.ENOSPC)
        self.assertEqual((self.root/'out/partial.tar').read_bytes(),expected[:31])
        self.assertEqual(fd_set(),before_fds)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Output already exists'):SDK.build(self.root,'out/partial.tar')
        self.assertEqual((self.root/'out/partial.tar').read_bytes(),expected[:31])
        self.assertEqual(fd_set(),before_fds)
        observed.append({'control':'injected-ENOSPC-after-real-prefix-write','classification':'authored-failure-injection-with-real-filesystem','residual_bytes':31,'result':'exception-no-success','overwrite_refused':True,'descriptors_closed':True})

        observed.append({'control':'actual-FIFO-input','result':'rejected','descriptors_closed':True})
